job.rules: Sort by color, but blue things stay where they are.

checks.text: All red objects are in the left bin.
All green objects are in the middle bin.
All blue objects remain where they started on the table.

spec.rationale: The sentence says to sort by color, so red and green objects each get their own bin, assigned to the left and middle bins respectively because the sentence does not name specific bins. Blue objects are the stated exception, so they are left in place with an unmoved check.

attempts.notes: Sorts red objects into the left bin and green objects into the middle bin, while registering blue objects as obstacles so they remain unmoved.

seeds.error: SkillError: cannot reach pose (0.271, -0.050, 0.550) yaw 81 deg (IK error 2.2 cm)

attempts.diagnosis: Avoiding the blue cubes forced an unreachable over-the-blue waypoint while carrying the red cube, aborting the program before placement.
